title: Held out: children and social media
note: Held-out set. An attack on a panelist's experience in words no cue lists, a protest that returns to the question, a moderator's move to an audience question, a nod.

turns.speaker: MOD
turns.text: Tonight, social media and children. Minister, when will the age checks come in?

turns.speaker: MIN
turns.text: The age checks will be in place by next September.

turns.speaker: CMP
turns.text: You said last year they would be in place by this September.

turns.speaker: MIN
turns.text: With respect, the campaigner has never had to run a government department.

turns.speaker: MOD
turns.text: Let's bring in the audience question on screen time. How much screen time is too much for a ten year old?

turns.speaker: CMP
turns.text: Most experts say no more than two hours a day.

turns.speaker: MIN
turns.text: And we will publish guidance for parents in the spring.
